name: Jorkeam
overview: Jorkeam is a male figure from the tribe of Judah, known primarily as the son of Raham. Beyond this genealogical detail, Scripture provides no further notes or distinguishing attributes about him. His mention situates him within the lineage of Judah, an important tribe in biblical history.
namesAndTitles: The name Jorkeam appears as a proper name in Scripture without an explicit meaning or divine origin indicated. Therefore, it is simply recognized as a personal name recorded in 1 Chronicles 2:44.
familyAndRelationships: Jorkeam is identified as the son of Raham, establishing a direct paternal relationship. Scripture does not record any additional family connections beyond this.
scriptureSignificance: Jorkeam's significance lies in his place within the genealogical record of the tribe of Judah, highlighting the continuity of God's chosen lineage. His mention in 1 Chronicles 2:44 contributes to the detailed biblical genealogies that affirm God's providential care over His people and the fulfillment of His promises through the tribe of Judah.
